result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in all the listings you named. The full suite passes: 609 tests, no failures.

What changed:

- **`model/Promotion.java`**: added `String description` as the last record component. It is null when none was given.
- **`resources/schema.sql`**: added a nullable `description VARCHAR(255)` column to `promotion`. The database is built fresh from this file each time, so no migration is needed.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: `createPromotion` takes an optional `description` as a new last parameter. A null or blank value is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled. I kept the existing 5-argument method as an overload that passes null, so the existing callers and tests did not need to change.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description, the row mapper reads it, and every promotion SELECT now includes it. That covers active-on-date, active-in-region, by-category, best-for-category-on-date, unused-in-period, and find-by-code.
- **`src/test/.../PromotionDescriptionTest.java`** (new): checks that "Summer sale on all hardware" comes back from each listing, and that a promotion created without one has a null description.

I did not change `DemoScenario`, and nothing is committed.
